_comment: Pilot profile overlay — inject connection strings at deploy (env / Key Vault; do not commit secrets). Loaded after base appsettings and before appsettings.Advanced.json (see ArchLucid.Api/Program.cs). Skipped in Development so local appsettings.Development.json is not clobbered. Does not set AgentExecution:Mode=Real or partial AzureOpenAI (those belong in appsettings.Real.sample.json / env / user secrets — docs/library/FIRST_REAL_VALUE.md). Partial AzureOpenAI without an API key fails local and Simulator startup.
